Meal kits

Dinner, without the shopping list.

Every kit arrives chilled with what the recipe needs and nothing it doesn't, so less ends up in the bin.

Choose your dishes

Pick from soups, salads, mains and desserts. Every kit comes in two sizes: for 2 or for 4 people.

We deliver, any day

Three slots a day: 10 am to 12 noon, 2 to 4 pm, or 6 to 8 pm. Move a delivery until 10 pm the day before.

Cook and enjoy

Keep the kit chilled and cook it within 3 days. Most dishes are on the table in 40 minutes or less.

Our story

Maison Karkadé. A welcome at every table.

Maison Karkadé cooks the food we grew up with, from koshari and molokhia to freekeh, mandi and kunafa. We serve it in our dining rooms, and we pack it so you can make it at home on a weeknight.

Our head office is in Cairo and our kitchens, each with a dining room, are in Cairo, Beirut, Riyadh and Dubai. A team of 140 writes, tests and packs 180 recipes, and each one has a recipe card that names its ingredients and its allergens. That card is the single source of truth for our cooks, our care team and Zad, our assistant.

Our crowned red hibiscus, gold details and two-line Maison Karkadé wordmark express our identity: generous hospitality and a shared table.

Meet Zad

Answers at any hour.

Zad is our AI assistant. It answers from our recipe cards, allergen chart and policies, tells you which source it used, and hands you to a person whenever you ask. Our care team is here every day from 8 am to 10 pm.

Help

Questions we hear every day

How many people does a kit serve?

Every kit comes in two sizes: for 2 or for 4 people.

How long do the kits stay fresh?

Keep the kit chilled and cook it within 3 days of delivery.

When can I get my delivery?

Any day of the week, in one of three slots: 10 am to 12 noon, 2 to 4 pm, or 6 to 8 pm.

Where do you deliver?

Cairo, Giza, Beirut, Riyadh and Dubai.

How do I skip a week?

In the app or by asking Zad, until Wednesday midnight for the following week.

How do I change my payment card?

In the app: Account, then Payment. Never send card details in a chat.

My box arrived damaged. What now?

Tell us within 48 hours, with a photo if you can. You choose a free replacement or a full refund.

Do you have vegetarian dishes?

Yes. Vegetarian recipe cards are marked "vegetarian".

Can you tell me which dishes contain an allergen?

Yes. Zad answers from the recipe cards and the allergen chart and names the card it used. For a severe allergy, ask to speak to a person.

Who am I talking to?

Zad is an AI assistant. Our care team is available every day from 8 am to 10 pm, and Zad can hand you over at any time.

I work at a company on the at Work plan. How do I order lunch?

Order by 10 am and lunch reaches your desk by 12 noon.

Can I eat at Maison Karkadé?

Yes. Each of our four kitchens, in Cairo, Beirut, Riyadh and Dubai, has a dining room, open every day from 12 noon to 11 pm.

How do I book a table?

With the "Book a table" button on this site or in the app, for up to 8 guests. For a larger group, ask our care team.

Dining rooms, meal kits and office lunches from the Levant and the Nile.

Care team: every day, 8 am to 10 pm.
Zad: at any hour.
